pitcher plant: A pitcher plant catches insects in the sweet liquid inside its leaves.

Raffesia arnoldii: Raffesia arnoldii is famous for producing the largest single flower in the world.

nectar: Bees fly from flower to flower to collect sweet nectar.

humming-bird: A humming-bird can stay still in the air while it drinks nectar.
